name: Large Missing-Pattern Conditions Guarantee Every Prescribed Sink
statement: Let $H\ne\varnothing$ be ample and retain its minimally missing patterns of support at least three. Every vertex of $H$ is the sink of an acyclic unique-sink orientation if there are at most two such patterns, or if every pair agrees wherever their supports overlap. Hence every ample forbidden pc-minor for dismantlable ampleness, and every rooted obstruction factor, has at least three large minimally missing patterns, with two disagreeing on a common coordinate. Binary missing patterns are unrestricted in both sufficient conditions.
proof: The two signed geometric criteria construct a bounded full-dimensional convex polytope whose strict coordinate-sign class is $H$. The coordinate hyperplanes on this polytope give the required realization, and the realizable prescribed-endpoint theorem supplies a peeling, hence an acyclic USO, to every selected vertex. Contraposition gives both necessary conditions for forbidden classes and rooted factors.
comments: The criteria are sufficient rather than necessary. Failure of both is not a negative certificate for dismantlable ampleness.
